indian-retail-fno-traders-community.problem: Learn options basics from a cheap course before the first trades
indian-retail-fno-traders-community.note: Reused from the old ladder. Entry-level course price on the vendor's own page.

indian-retail-fno-traders-community.problem: See and manage positions: an options analytics subscription plus paid charting (Sensibull, TradingView)
indian-retail-fno-traders-community.note: Reused from the old ladder (vendor support page). TradingView Essential was seen this pass at ₹1,295 monthly (https://mrchartist.com/learn/tradingview/pricing-and-plans); folded in because both solve 'analyse the market', and traders often pay for both.

indian-retail-fno-traders-community.problem: Backtest and automate strategies on a no-code algo platform after discretionary trading loses money (AlgoTest, Quantsapp, Tradetron)
indian-retail-fno-traders-community.note: AlgoTest starter plan seen this pass on the vendor's blog. Replaces the old Quantsapp price (Rs 1229 monthly) that came from a third-party review page. Same problem as old step 3, renamed to say why traders reach it.

indian-retail-fno-traders-community.problem: Pay for a mentorship program or premium community after losing money on their own
indian-retail-fno-traders-community.note: Six-month Trading Mentorship Program price seen in search this pass. The old step had no price (Kundan Kishore page). Paid Telegram call groups sit in the same step; they are unregistered advice, so only education-style mentorship is counted.

indian-retail-fno-traders-community.problem: File ITR-3 at year end, with a Section 44AB tax audit if turnover or losses require it
indian-retail-fno-traders-community.price_text: Rs 2,499 for ITR-3 without audit and Rs 14,999 with Section 44AB tax audit
indian-retail-fno-traders-community.note: Reused from the old ladder. Every trader with F&O turnover must file ITR-3; those with losses to carry forward usually pay a CA.

indian-startup-founders-community.problem: Incorporate the private limited company (CA or online filing service, including government fees and stamp duty)
indian-startup-founders-community.note: New step. Incorporation is the first thing founders pay for; the old ladder folded it into annual compliance. Range seen for a standard 2-director company.

indian-startup-founders-community.problem: Protect the brand: trademark filing (government fee per class plus a filing agent)
indian-startup-founders-community.note: New step. Government fee for startups and MSMEs with a DPIIT or Udyam certificate; the same page range shows professional fees of ₹1,499 to ₹30,000 on top.

indian-startup-founders-community.problem: Stay compliant every year: ROC filings, GST returns, statutory audit and ITR through a CA
indian-startup-founders-community.note: Reused from the old ladder (old step 1, now narrowed to the recurring annual cost).

indian-startup-founders-community.problem: Run customer support and sales follow-up on the WhatsApp Business API (Wati, Interakt, AiSensy), later with AI agents on top
indian-startup-founders-community.note: Replaces the old 'AI voice and WhatsApp agents' step priced at Vapi's $0.05 per minute. The WhatsApp API subscription is the purchase Indian startups commonly make today; AI agents ride on it. Per-conversation charges apply on top.

indian-startup-founders-community.problem: Hire the first team: paid job postings and recruiter packages (Naukri, LinkedIn)
indian-startup-founders-community.note: New step. Classified job posting price per job seen this pass. Nearly every startup that grows past the founders pays for at least postings.

indian-startup-founders-community.problem: Raise a round: a valuation report from a registered valuer and the shareholders' agreement
indian-startup-founders-community.note: Reused valuation-report price from the old ladder. Shareholders' agreement drafting was seen this pass at Rs. 8,000 to Rs. 25,000 (https://www.registerkaro.in/shareholders-agreement); folded in because both are the same problem, closing the round.

indian-startup-founders-community.problem: After the raise: set up an ESOP pool and policy to hire with equity
indian-startup-founders-community.note: New step. ESOP scheme design price seen this pass. Only funded startups reach it, but nearly all of them do. The old step 4 (AI-search visibility at $95 per month) and step 5 (community events, no price) were dropped: neither is a common paid spend for this room yet.

study-abroad-consultancies-india.problem: Get student enquiries in season: paid Google and Meta ads or bought lead packs
study-abroad-consultancies-india.note: New step, placed first because leads come before the CRM. Meta leads were seen at ₹80–₹400 in the same search; lead vendors sell prepaid packs (IndiaStudyChannel takes pre-payment in multiples of Rs 10,000).

study-abroad-consultancies-india.problem: Track and follow up hundreds of enquiries: a study-abroad CRM with WhatsApp API messaging
study-abroad-consultancies-india.note: Reused CRM price from the old ladder. Old step 3 (WhatsApp API, ₹3,499 at https://www.zoko.io/post/interakt-pricing-guide) folded in: one problem, enquiry follow-up.

study-abroad-consultancies-india.problem: Be recognised by universities: join the agents' association (annual fee)
study-abroad-consultancies-india.note: Reused from the old ladder. AAERI covers Australia-focused agents; AAEC is the newer general association.

study-abroad-consultancies-india.problem: Certify counsellors so universities and visa offices accept the agency (EATC or IATC exam)
study-abroad-consultancies-india.note: New step. Exam fee seen this pass; the same page shows €99 for AAERI members. Australian providers require a qualified counsellor, and other destinations increasingly ask for ICEF training.

study-abroad-consultancies-india.problem: Sign more university contracts by attending agent workshops and fairs (ICEF)
study-abroad-consultancies-india.note: New step. Participation fee for semi-sponsored agents seen this pass. Old steps 4 (test-prep partnership) and 5 (loan referrals) dropped: they earn the consultancy commission rather than cost it money.

excel-financial-modellers-competition-co.problem: Compete: enter Financial Modeling World Cup stages and the Excel esports season
excel-financial-modellers-competition-co.price_text: $25 for the Open age group and $15 for the U-25 age group
excel-financial-modellers-competition-co.note: Reused from the old ladder. Old step 2 (Microsoft Excel World Championship, $50 for the season 2025, https://fmworldcup.com/microsoft-excel-world-championship/rules/) folded in: same problem, competing, run by the same organiser.

excel-financial-modellers-competition-co.problem: Get faster and better: a modellers' training community or course subscription (Full Stack Modeller, CFI)
excel-financial-modellers-competition-co.note: Price seen this pass for the base subscription (lifetime £2,500). CFI's $497 billed annually (old step 4) is the same problem and is folded in.

excel-financial-modellers-competition-co.problem: Prove it with letters: sit an accreditation exam (FMI Advanced Financial Modeler or FMVA)
excel-financial-modellers-competition-co.note: Reused from the old ladder. FMVA is the alternative credential; its exam comes inside the CFI subscription in step 2.

excel-financial-modellers-competition-co.problem: Go in person: a training camp tied to the live finals
excel-financial-modellers-competition-co.note: New step. Training camp ticket seen this pass; it includes access to the Microsoft Excel World Championship finals. Only the committed core travels, so this is the top of the ladder, not a step for everyone. Old step 5 (Full Stack bundle, no price) merged into step 2.

finra-series-79-sie-new-hires.problem: Pass the SIE and Series 79 inside the firm's window: a prep package, question bank and, if needed, tutoring
finra-series-79-sie-new-hires.note: Knopman Marks Series 79 prep starting price seen this pass. The $395 exam fee per attempt (old price, https://www.certfuel.com/series-79/getting-started/what-is-series-79/) is usually paid by the firm; the hire pays for extra prep.

finra-series-79-sie-new-hires.problem: Series 63 and state registration right after
finra-series-79-sie-new-hires.note: Exam fee seen this pass; the old step had no price.

finra-series-79-sie-new-hires.problem: Get deal-ready fast: three-statement, DCF and LBO modelling before the first live mandate
finra-series-79-sie-new-hires.note: Premium Package price seen on the vendor page this pass; the old step had no price.

finra-series-79-sie-new-hires.problem: Yearly FINRA continuing education (Regulatory Element) before the December 31 deadline
finra-series-79-sie-new-hires.note: Session fee per completion seen in FINRA's fee schedule this pass; small, but a recurring rule-driven payment.

finra-series-79-sie-new-hires.problem: Add the CFA for the next move (Level I registration)
finra-series-79-sie-new-hires.price_text: US$1,140 during early registration or US$1,490 during standard registration
finra-series-79-sie-new-hires.note: 2026 fee seen this pass; the old step had no price. A minority of analysts take it, mostly those aiming at the buy side, but it is a well-trodden route.

dental-practice-owners-clinics.problem: Stop losing patients to missed calls: a practice phone, texting and reminder system, plus after-hours answering (human service or AI receptionist)
dental-practice-owners-clinics.note: Reused Weave price from the old ladder. Old step 3 (AI receptionist at $0.05 per minute on Vapi) folded in: dental answering services were seen this pass at $200 and $500 per month (https://www.getviva.ai/dental-answering-service-cost/), which is the same problem.

dental-practice-owners-clinics.problem: Clinic management software for appointments, records and billing
dental-practice-owners-clinics.note: Reused from the old ladder (India price). US practices pay far more for Dentrix or Open Dental hosting; no US price was pinned this pass.

dental-practice-owners-clinics.problem: Fill the chairs: a dental marketing agency for local SEO and Google Ads
dental-practice-owners-clinics.note: New step. Typical monthly SEO spend seen this pass; the same page shows a $750 to $5,000 range and separate Google Ads budgets.

dental-practice-owners-clinics.problem: Get paid by insurers without a full-time coordinator: outsourced dental billing
dental-practice-owners-clinics.note: New step, US-specific. Percentage-of-collections pricing seen this pass; flat fees of $1,000 to $5,000 per month also seen.

dental-practice-owners-clinics.problem: Keep the licence and stay current: association dues and continuing education
dental-practice-owners-clinics.note: ADA national dues for 2026 seen this pass; state and local dues come on top. The old step cited the Indian Dental Association page with no price.

dental-practice-owners-clinics.problem: Buy a second practice or sell to a group: broker commission on the deal
dental-practice-owners-clinics.note: Commission range seen this pass; the old step had no price. Valuation and financing sit inside the same transaction.

eu-ai-act-deadline-ai-product-teams.problem: Meet the AI literacy duty: train staff with a certificate course
eu-ai-act-deadline-ai-product-teams.note: Vendor price seen this pass; the old step had no price. Deeper open courses were seen at €49 to €1,395 per person in the same search.

eu-ai-act-deadline-ai-product-teams.problem: Classify each system and get a gap assessment from a specialist law firm or consultant
eu-ai-act-deadline-ai-product-teams.note: New step, split out of old step 1 because classification is bought from a professional while training is bought per seat. Fixed-price examples were seen at €1,250 per system and EUR 9,900 for a readiness sprint (https://embedai.nl/en/diensten/ai-act-software-of-consultant).

eu-ai-act-deadline-ai-product-teams.problem: Keep the paperwork alive: compliance software for transparency notices, technical documentation, logging and post-market monitoring
eu-ai-act-deadline-ai-product-teams.note: Reused SME tier from the old ladder. Old step 3 (portfolio platform at €199/month, https://complymates.com/pricing) and old step 4 (post-market monitoring) folded in: one problem, ongoing compliance records, at different scales.

eu-ai-act-deadline-ai-product-teams.problem: High-risk systems (hiring, credit, biometrics): third-party conformity assessment by a notified body
eu-ai-act-deadline-ai-product-teams.note: Range seen this pass. Only the high-risk slice of the room reaches this step, but for them it is mandatory.

eu-ai-act-deadline-ai-product-teams.problem: Pass enterprise buyers' AI questionnaires: ISO 42001 certification
eu-ai-act-deadline-ai-product-teams.note: Initial certification audit cost seen this pass; the old step had no price. Surveillance audits of $3,500–$9,000 a year follow.

retiring-owners-selling-business.problem: Find out what the business is worth: a formal valuation
Get sale-ready: an exit planning advisor to clean up financials, reduce owner dependence and time the exit
retiring-owners-selling-business.note: Retainer range seen this pass; the old step had no price. Larger sellers add a sell-side quality of earnings report, seen at $15,000-$25,000 for sub-$3M EBITDA businesses (https://ctacquisitions.com/quality-of-earnings-report-seller-deep-dive/).

retiring-owners-selling-business.problem: Find a buyer: broker commission on the sale
Close the deal: an M&A attorney for the purchase agreement and a CPA for tax structuring
retiring-owners-selling-business.note: Seller-side attorney fee range seen this pass; the old step had no price. Flat fees of $7,500-$20,000 were seen for asset sales under $1M-$2M.

retiring-owners-selling-business.problem: After the sale: a financial adviser manages the proceeds
retiring-owners-selling-business.note: Typical AUM fee seen this pass; the old step had no price. Needs a licensed adviser, so this is a partner step.
